title: Giving an item to an employee

posts.name: Khaled El-Shiekh
posts.cooked: in my company, I could give an item to an employee as a gift so I need to be able to move items from stock to employee and show which employee got which item

posts.name: Furkan Kardame
posts.cooked:
If it is a gift then it is an expense and not an asset. You need to issue the item out of the system using stock entry, material issue and use gift expense account. In stock entry you can add a custom field with tick and then a field with employee name, so using that you should be able to generate report of stock issue which are gifts and who received the gifts.
Hope this explains the answer to your requirement in detail.
Good luck.

posts.name: Siphexxd
posts.cooked: Rediscovering this topic and wondering if anyone has tried linking the stock entry to an Expense Claim or a simple custom doctype to track gifts more cleanly. I’ve found that adding a link field for the employee works well, but I’m curious if there’s a smoother way to report on gift history without custom scripts. Has anyone set up a workflow that covers both accounting and HR needs?
